backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing reminder and messaging system with role-based access control (user/admin), profile management, and CRUD operations for reminders and messages.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: replacing app logo with VoiceMate branding and rendering logo as static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON summary of all frontend files describing components for authentication, voice input/output, reminders, messaging, and landing page with VoiceMate branding.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color palette (terracotta/sand/amber theme) and CSS custom properties for light/dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with VoiceMate title and root div for React app mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component managing routing between landing page (unauthenticated), profile setup dialog (first-time users), and main app layout with reminders/messages views.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog prompting new users to enter their display name and save profile to backend.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingP: Marketing landing page with hero section, VoiceMate logo, feature grid (reminders/messaging/voice/privacy), and login button for unauthenticated visitors.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with header, navigation between reminders and messages views, user profile display, and footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Messag: Form component for composing and sending messages to other users by Principal ID, with voice input support for message content.
Displays a list of sent and received messages with sender/recipient info, timestamps, optional reminder attachments, and delete functionality.
Main messages view that displays user's Principal ID with copy button, message composer, and list of all messages.
frontend/src/components/reminders/DueNow: Alert panel that displays reminders currently due with quick complete action buttons, hidden when no reminders are due.
frontend/src/components/reminders/Remind: Modal dialog for creating or editing reminders with title, notes, due date/time fields, and voice input support for title and notes.

Displays a filterable list of reminders with options to mark complete, edit, delete, send, and speak each reminder. Includes loading states, empty states, and formatting for due dates with visual indicators for overdue and today's reminders.
Button component that uses text-to-speech to read reminder details aloud, with toggle to stop playback.
Main reminders view component that combines a header with 'New Reminder' button, DueNowPanel for urgent reminders, RemindersList for all reminders, and ReminderEditor dialog.
frontend/src/components/reminders/SendRe: Dialog component for sending a reminder as a message to another user by entering their Principal ID, with form validation and loading states.
Button component that integrates speech-to-text functionality, showing visual feedback during recording and handling browser compatibility with disabled state for unsupported browsers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor with authentication, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Hook that combines Internet Identity authentication state with user profile data, providing a unified interface for current user information including principal and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useDueNowReminders.ts: Hook that filters reminders to find incomplete ones with due dates that have passed, checking every 30 seconds and converting timestamps to nanoseconds for comparison.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and provider component, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, reminders CRUD, messages, and sending reminders as messages, with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechToText.ts: Hook that wraps the Web Speech API for speech recognition, managing listening state, transcript results, browser compatibility detection, and error handling with start/stop/reset controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useTextToSpeech.ts: React hook that wraps the browser's SpeechSynthesis API to provide text-to-speech functionality with speak/stop controls and speaking state tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earthy color palette (terracotta, sand, amber) for light and dark modes, plus a voice-pulse animation component.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup helpers for managing parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH color variables, sidebar colors, border radius tokens, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a shared-access organizer app (VoiceMate) with voice features and messaging for reminders, explicitly configured with no authentication/login requirements.
